facts.fact: Matin Libre reports that on 1 September 2026 the land-affairs directorate of Parakou's mairie presented 196,474 parcels registered in the national cadastre, citing figures from the e-Foncier Bénin platform, and showed a visiting Netherlands embassy delegation its working system for updating cadastral data; the article does not say how the office is connected.

Matin Libre names one commune, Parakou, whose mairie runs a system for updating its data in the national cadastre as of 1 September 2026; it gives no total of communes doing so, and beneficiaries ask for the project to continue in other communes.

systems.owner: not stated; the Agence nationale du domaine et du foncier (ANDF) and the PPMEC project are thanked as partners
systems.tiers: the commune of Parakou, at the mairie's Direction des Affaires domaniales et environnementales

note: The connection is inferred from the commune working in a national platform; the article states no connection as such.
